hero.eyebrow: The digital timeline of your olive grove
hero.title: Nobody knows your olive grove better than you.
hero.leadProduct: Oleachron keeps it, completes it, and carries it through time.
hero.body: Tasks, observations, photos, weather, and harvests come together into one clear story for every grove.
hero.shotAlt: The grove Chronologio on a phone

promises.recordText: Tasks, observations, photos, and the things only you know about your grove.
promises.dataText: Weather, conditions, and field information give context to what actually happened.
promises.passText: Family, partners, and agronomists can understand the grove’s story — today or years from now.

problem.title: Years of knowledge don’t fit in a notebook.
questions: When did this problem first appear?
What did you change before the good harvest?
How much had it rained before the spray?
problem.someScattered: Some of it lives in papers, photos, and messages.
problem.someLost: And some of it, with time, is lost.
problem.close: Oleachron was made so it isn’t.

brandMoment.intro: Every record becomes part of your grove’s story.

chronologio.title: The Chronologio of your olive grove.
chronologio.text: Everything that happened in the field, organized at the moment it happened.
chronologio.range: Look at a month, a whole growing year, or go back to earlier seasons.
chronologio.tasksText: What was done, when, and by whom.
chronologio.notesText: Notes and photos that keep their value because they are not lost.
chronologio.weatherText: The conditions around every important event.
chronologio.harvestText: See how the grove evolves beyond the day’s work.

knowledge.title: Your experience is the most important data.
knowledge.p1: Oleachron does not try to replace what you know.
knowledge.p3: And around your own knowledge it adds available data and information, so you see every event in its real context.
knowledge.weRemember: Oleachron remembers when it happened, and what was happening around it.
knowledge.together: Together they make something far more useful than a simple archive.

beforeAfter.title: From scattered information to a shared memory.
beforeItems: “I think we did it last May…”

sharing.title: Knowledge is worth more when it can be passed on.
sharing.text: An olive grove is rarely one person’s work.
sharing.share: Share the real picture with the people who need it — without explaining everything from scratch every time.
sharing.familyText: The knowledge of the grove is not lost from one generation to the next.
sharing.partnersText: Everyone can know what happened and what still needs to be done.
sharing.agronomistText: Advice can rest on a real history, not only on how the grove looks today.

timeValue.title: Every year makes Oleachron more valuable.
timeValue.year1: The first year, you start recording.
timeValue.year3: The third, you begin to see patterns.
timeValue.bridge: And over time you create something that cannot be bought ready-made:
timeValue.close: The knowledge of your own olive grove.

simpleUse.title: In the field, you need simplicity.
simpleUse.p1: You don’t need to become a software expert.
simpleUse.close: Oleachron makes sure everything finds the right place, at the right time.
simpleUse.shotAlt: Recording a task from the phone

steps.title: Start writing its story.
steps.step1Text: The field becomes the foundation of its story.
steps.step3Text: Oleachron organizes the information through time and adds the context it needs.

future.title: You are not only recording the past.
future.p1: You use the past to understand today.
future.p2: And today to prepare better for next season.

alpha.title: Start free
alpha.text: During alpha, access is free for real use in the grove. Web and Android.
installSteps: Download the APK to your Android phone.
If Android asks, allow installation from this source.
Create an account or sign in.
alpha.safety: Install only from the official Oleachron page. This is an alpha — some features may change.

demo.title: Request a demo
demo.subtitle: Tell us about your olive groves and we will get in touch.
demo.name: Your name
demo.message: What would you like to see?

cta.kicker: Keep the knowledge. Build the story.
cta.title: Your grove’s story has already begun.
cta.text: The question is whether you will remember it.

footer.description: The knowledge of your olive grove, through time.
